sources.stated_purpose: Public defender consortium grievance procedures only.
sources.limitations: The superior court's public grievance page expressly names the consortium director and publishes this professional mailbox for complaints about public defenders. This is not a general health care grievance channel. Public defenders serve eligible clients in matters within their statutory or contracted remit; the address is not an independent medical-abuse investigation or general civil legal advice channel. Reconfirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction, eligibility and channel purpose before use. Do not send confidential information by ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
